title: Was Next hacked? Supplier data breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Next, the London Stock Exchange, any news outlet, regulator, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: No count of affected people applies. Large rests on potential reach, not a measured impact: Next has 800+ stores in the UK and Ireland and sells online, and the supplier is unnamed. Next says no customer personal data is known to be affected. Revisit if more is disclosed.
who_is_affected: Next, whose data a supplier held. Next says no customer personal data is known to be affected; the supplier is unnamed and its other customers are unknown. Be wary of unexpected emails, texts or calls claiming to be from Next, as an outside security firm advised.

known.text: Next told the stock exchange that a supplier's cyber incident gave outsiders access to certain Next data.

not_known.text: Whether any customer personal data was taken.
